messages.subject: prediction with test data
parts:
Dear all,

I have fitted a spatial (Besag model), temporal (RW1) and spatio-temporal interaction model (type IV interaction with 'generic0') along with 8 covariates (environment and demographic). The fitted values are in good agreement with observations over the training period (includes 72 months from 2013-2018, and 502 blocks). The monthly trend in incidence follows a pattern (increase from Jan to reach a peak in march followed by a decline) in all the years in the training period. However, when I predicted the incidence for the test period (Jan 2019-Dec 2020), the predicted patterns were not as observed (as in the training period), instead continue to increase during the test period. 

I do not understand the reason for a completely different patterns (increasing trend as against the pattern during the training period) during the test period.  I am not sure, if my codes and the data input for prediction  periods are correct. I have assigned "NA" for the response variable and covariates data are as observed for the test periods. 

Appreciate your guidance / suggestions to improve the model predictions for the test period. 

For your kind information the I am attaching the r-script and the graphs for the training and test period. 

Best,
S. Subramanian
